title: Batch URL Downloader
description: Paste multiple media URLs, inspect compatible Cove downloaders, apply initial metadata tags, and queue background batch downloads.

blocks.text: Open Paste & Download from the navigation bar to extract HTTP/HTTPS URLs from plain text, Markdown, or chat logs and queue them into your Cove library.

items: Paste one or more URLs into the Paste URLs box. Duplicate and trailing punctuation are cleaned automatically.
Optionally select a Studio, Tags, or Performers under Initial Metadata Tagging to pre-tag every queued item.
Click Inspect Downloaders to check which installed downloader matches each URL and preview available quality options.
Click Queue Downloads to start the background download job.

blocks.text: By default, every inspected URL uses Auto (Max Height), which defers to Cove's MaxDownloadHeight setting so your resolution cap is always respected.
If you want to override your global cap for a specific item, pick an explicit stream resolution from its Quality dropdown before queueing.

rows: Extract and match URLs concurrently against installed downloaders
Queue matched URLs into a background download-batch job
